breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant, computing T_int₁ = +200,000 N·mm for segment 0→800 mm and T_int₂ = -50,000 N·mm for segment 800→1200 mm. This properly accounts for the intermediate applied torque at x = 800 mm, rather than using a single uniform torque over the full shaft length as the incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed.
